name: Update XAUUSD data pack

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

  schedule:
    # ทุก 4 ชั่วโมง จันทร์-ศุกร์
    # GitHub Actions ใช้เวลา UTC
    - cron: "10 */4 * * 1-5"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Check API Secret
        env:
          TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY secret is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY found"

      - name: Build XAUUSD and News data packs
        env:
          TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          node update-data.mjs

      - name: Check generated files
        run: |
          echo "Checking generated files..."

          if [ ! -f "xauusd.json" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: xauusd.json was not created"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -f "news.json" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: news.json was not created"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "xauusd.json OK"
          echo "news.json OK"

          ls -lh xauusd.json news.json

      - name: Commit changed data
        run: |
          git config user.name "one-month-data-bot"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add xauusd.json news.json

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No market data changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "data: update XAUUSD market pack"
          git push
